Presenting the video for the title track of Bhool Bhulaiyaa. The film Bhool Bhulaiyaa is a comedy horror film directed by Priyadarshan. The movie featured Akshay Kumar, Shiney Ahuja, Vidya Balan, Ameesha Patel, Paresh Rawal, Manoj Joshi, Asrani, Rajpal Yadav, and Vikram Gokhale.
Song - Bhool Bhulaiyaa
Film - Bhool Bhulaiyaa
Music Director - Pritam
Singer - Neeraj Shridhar
Lyricist - Sameer
Artist - Akshay Kumar, Vidya Balan
Mix & Master- Eric Pillai @ Future Sound Of Bombay
